description: Create an Airflow DAG for fintech_app that rebuilds the daily card_authorizations partition in Postgres in a way that is safe under retries and manual re-runs. The DAG should: (1) build the day's data into a scratch table named with the run's ds_nodash, (2) validate row count and amount checksum against the source, (3) in a single transaction detach/drop the existing day partition and attach the scratch table as the new partition, (4) drop leftover scratch tables older than 3 days. Tasks retry 3 times with a 5-minute delay. A failed validation must leave the existing production partition untouched.
edge_cases: The scratch table build must start with DROP TABLE IF EXISTS so a retry does not append to a half-built table
The swap must be atomic; a failure between detach and attach must not leave the day without a partition
Day boundary: auth_date is derived from auth_ts converted to UTC, half-open [ds, ds + 1 day)
Scratch cleanup must not drop the scratch table of the currently running date during a backfill
common_failure_modes: FM6: INSERT INTO the scratch table without a drop duplicates rows on retry
FM2: BETWEEN ds AND ds+1 includes midnight of the next day in two partitions
FM7: Validation compares counts only, missing amount corruption from a bad cast
